subject: arcadeCabinet

The right side mirrors the opposite way, so the same decal art reads in flipped directions on each side—a symmetric mirrored look that's fine for the cabinet. Now I'm planning the texture set: side art panels, marquee, screen, control panel plate, kickplate, and coin door label, aiming for 5-12 textures total alongside body paint materials.
